en.t: The Minister of the Left immediately came out to see him off.

units.source_text: 悲伤不堪，只管以袖掩面。

en.t: Overcome with grief, he could only cover his face with his sleeve.

units.source_text: 左右侍从睹此情状，无不感动泣下。

en.t: The attendants on either side saw this and were all moved to tears.

units.source_text: 源氏大将抚今思昔，悲从中来，热泪盈眶，愁容可掬，然而举止安详，仪态优美。

en.t: General Genji thought of the present and the past, and sorrow rose within him; hot tears filled his eyes and grief showed plainly on his face, yet his bearing remained calm and graceful.

units.source_text: 左大臣迟疑良久，对公子言道：“老夫年迈，不任忧患。

en.t: After hesitating for a long while, the Minister of the Left said to the young lord, "I am old now and cannot bear such sorrow.

units.source_text: 即使小有失意，亦必伤心坠泪；

en.t: Even the slightest disappointment makes my heart ache and brings tears to my eyes;

units.source_text: 何况遭此巨厄，两袖无有干时。

en.t: how much more, then, after meeting with this great calamity, when my sleeves are never dry.
My heart is in turmoil, and I cannot control myself.
My conduct has lost its usual composure, and I can hardly face anyone.

units.source_text: 深恐颓丧之余，有失礼仪，因此不敢晋谒上皇。

en.t: I deeply fear that in my dejection I might fail in proper courtesy, and so I have not dared to go before the Retired Emperor.

units.source_text: 吾婿入宫，便中望将此等情状奏闻，善为说辞。

en.t: When my son-in-law enters the palace, I hope he will find a suitable moment to report these circumstances and speak well on my behalf.

units.source_text: 衰朽之年，来日无多，岂料遭此逆事，真乃命途多舛！”

en.t: In my declining years, with few days left to me, who would have thought I would meet with such misfortune? Truly, my fate has been full of hardship!"

units.source_text: 他强自镇静，好容易说出了这番话，样子实甚可怜。

en.t: He forced himself to remain calm and managed with great difficulty to say these words; his appearance was truly pitiable.
